station: Mai Chau (former Mai Chau district town, Hoa Binh province; now xa Mai Chau, Phu Tho province)
source: Vietnam Institute for Building Science and Technology, QCVN 02:2022/BXD (Circular 02/2022/TT-BXD, 26/09/2022), climate data supplied by IMHEN; values as transcribed in the climate box of en.wikipedia 'Mai Chau district' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mai_Ch%C3%A2u_district). QCVN PDF: https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2022/10/02-bxd.pdf
period: QCVN 02:2022/BXD station normals; station record through c. 2017-2020; exact averaging period not stated (do not label as 1961-1990 or 1991-2020)
confidence: approximate (read on the Wikipedia page, which cites QCVN 02:2022; the QCVN Annex A tables themselves could not be extracted)
quality_notes: Record lows in the source box for Jan-Mar, Jun, Jul and Dec are identical to the Hoa Binh station and May is blank (probable copy error); record extremes are therefore NOT included here.
January (max+min)/2 = 20.2 degC vs mean 18.4 degC: larger gap than other months; treat January t_max/t_min with caution.
Monthly rain sums to 1758.0 mm vs stated 1756; sunshine sums to 1498.0 h vs stated 1494.

station_assignment.Tien Phong and Cao Son (former Da Bac di: no Da Bac station series found; use the Hoa Binh station below (assumption). Tien Phong lies at ~100 m by the Hoa Binh reservoir; Cao Son is higher: apply lapse-rate correction of about -0.55 degC per 100 m (assumption).

alternate_station.source: QCVN 02:2022/BXD as transcribed in en.wikipedia 'Hoa Binh (city)' climate box, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/H%C3%B2a_B%C3%ACnh_(city)

context: Thesis (Luong 2025, citing Bui et al. 2012) gives provincial Jan mean 14.9 degC, Jul 26.7 degC and 84-90% of rain in May-Oct; QCVN 02:2022 s.2.1.5.2 places western Hoa Binh at the southern limit of the Northwest (Tay Bac) climate: drier, warmer winters than the Red River Delta side.
